Chapter 557: Chapter 10 Goodwill from the ‘Ancient God’ (Please Subscribe)

“Door to the Myriad Realms…..”

Lin Yuan’s spirit was aroused.

The Door to the Myriad Realms was indeed Lin Yuan’s greatest trump card, incomparable to any other, even the Mysterious Gourd had to take a back seat.

He paid close attention to the changes in the Door to the Myriad Realms.

“Could this black sphere contain world coordinates that make the Door to the Myriad Realms vibrate on its own?”

Lin Yuan speculated in his mind; in the past few transits, only by getting close to the coordinates of other worlds could he cause the Door to the Myriad Realms to change.

...

Of course.

There could be other possibilities.

But Lin Yuan’s true understanding of the Door to the Myriad Realms was still limited.

His main issue was that he was too weak to have the Door to the Myriad Realms recognize him as its master.

He could only guess and speculate about the changes in the Door to the Myriad Realms.

“Can I take a look?” Lin Yuan looked at Xilan and spoke.

“What’s the big deal about that.” Xilan casually tossed the black sphere to Lin Yuan.

Hum.

The moment Lin Yuan’s right hand touched the black sphere, a stream of information traveled through his skin into his body, eventually integrating into the Door to the Myriad Realms.

At the very bottom of the Door to the Myriad Realms, behind the nine world coordinate imprints, new world coordinate information slowly emerged.

“It really is a world coordinate.”

Lin Yuan was invigorated.

“Is it the world coordinates of another dimension?”

Lin Yuan was even more delighted.

With the help of the Door to the Myriad Realms, world coordinates meant an unguarded treasury to Lin Yuan.

“Is the world coordinate the most precious treasure to oneself… Could this world coordinate be from the homeland of the owner of that place of opportunity?”

Lin Yuan guessed to himself.

According to Xilan’s explanation, the owner of the place of opportunity was a being from another dimension who had accidentally entered the dimensional rift, later becoming a follower of the great ‘Your Majesty’.

Stranded in the unfamiliar dimensional rift, the owner of the place of opportunity must have missed his homeland world greatly, but the spaces between different dimensions were like chasms that even Supreme Beings could not cross.

Even with the world coordinates of one’s homeland, it was meaningless.

The owner of the place of opportunity was a follower of the great ‘Your Majesty’ of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, and this ‘Your Majesty,’ based on current information, was at least a Supreme Being.

Lin Yuan didn’t believe the owner of the place of opportunity had never sought help from the great ‘Your Majesty’.

With world coordinates, Supreme Beings could lock onto any world within the same dimension, but for other dimensions… even Supreme Beings were helpless.

“Did you figure out anything?” Xilan looked at Lin Yuan expectantly.

He had an almost blind ‘adoration’ for Lin Yuan by now—he had studied the black sphere for half a day without understanding it, hoping that Lin Yuan could grasp something just by looking at it for a few moments.

“Nothing…..” Lin Yuan shook his head.

In fact, he already knew what this black sphere was and had replicated the most precious world coordinates inside it into the Door to the Myriad Realms.

But clearly, he couldn’t say that out loud.

Lin Yuan would not reveal any information about the Door to the Myriad Realms to anyone.

“I see…” Xilan sighed. Inside that place of opportunity, there were many treasures laid out, and he had followed the owner’s wishes and taken the most precious one to escape.

What about the other treasures? Maduo Traveler was close behind; Xilan only had time to take one of the treasures.

He thought it would be some great opportunity, but now, it seemed of little use.

This made Xilan somewhat frustrated. He had run the risk of his avatar being destroyed, being chased by Maduo Traveler for so long, only to find now it seemed like it was all for nothing?

“When I get back, I’ll hand it over to the three goddesses and see. Maybe they’ll know what it is?” Lin Yuan handed the black sphere back to Xilan.

This black sphere had lost its significance to Lin Yuan as the most important world coordinates inside had already been replicated.

“That’s also true.”

“Just because I don’t recognize it doesn’t mean the three goddesses won’t recognize it.”

Xilan nodded slightly; many of the treasures contained in the numerous places of opportunity within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm had rare origins.

It was quite normal that he couldn’t recognize it now.

The two of them continued to examine the black sphere for a while, and then they started talking about serious matters.

“Galaxy Master, what are your plans moving forward?” Xilan asked.

“I plan to take a look at the core area,” Lin Yuan said.

Many strong beings were curious about the core area of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and wanted to explore it.

Lin Yuan’s plan to visit the core area was completely normal and not a special request.

“The core area, huh…” Xilan pondered for a while, “I also plan to enter the core area this time.”

“Why don’t we go together?”

Xilan suggested.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm had been opened many times.

Xilan had also entered several times, wandering through many areas of the outer and inner regions.

He had yet to visit the core area.

Now was a good time to check it out.

“Galaxy Master, although my direct combat power is nowhere near yours, I’m not bad when it comes to fleeing and surviving,” Xilan said proactively.

He had easily escaped from Maduo Traveler, whose power was close to that of the Million Heavy Realm, which indeed spoke for itself.

Lin Yuan was not confident he could do the same.

When facing the pursuit of Maduo Traveler, Lin Yuan could stand still and blast him away.

But to use multiple Spatial Layers to prevent Maduo Traveler from touching him… that was difficult.

“That works,” Lin Yuan thought for a moment and didn’t refuse.

The core area was still far away; crossing the vast inner region would take at least ten to twenty years.

Having a companion for that time wasn’t such a bad idea.

As for entering the core area and facing that calling sensation…

When the time came, Lin Yuan could simply find an excuse to part ways with Xilan.

…..

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, his expression revealing a joyful color.
